detail.longDescription: RE: https:// hkc.social/@nick/1171851725359 43216 Yes, Nick is right. It would be a lot of work to develop a complete EQ only for Eloquence in NVDA, and probably not a good use of time when somebody is already doing this for our precious # NVDA . That somebody is LoLo, or Manolo on the NVDA Add-ons mailing list. His project is not tied to one synthesizer. He began by wondering why he had never seen a real audio-processing add-on for NVDA, then started experimenting with NVDA's PCM audio path. The simple EQ he began with soon became Audio Processor, a real-time multi-effect processor for speech, NVDA sounds, or all NVDA audio. The first experimental version already had: • high-pass and low-pass filters; • four parametric EQ bands; • output gain; • true stereo pan; • an 1176-style compressor; • a stereo Juno-style chorus; • delay; • stereo reverb; • a limiter. # Blind # SoundEngineering # AudioEngineering # ScreenReader # Accessibility # audio # NVDA # dev # programming # opensource
